/* HubSystemMngMapper.selectSubQnAList : 서브 문의사항(QnA) List */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
SELECT T2.REFERENCE_NO , T2.SEQ_NO , T2.QANDA_TYPE , (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = T1.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'QUESTION_TYPE' AND CODE = T1.QUESTION_TYPE) AS QUESTION_TYPE_NAME , T2.QUESTION_SEQ_NO , T2.CONTENTS , T2.FILE_CONTENT_TYPE , T2.ENT_CODE , CASE WHEN T2.FILE_TEMP_NAME IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(T2.FILE_TEMP_NAME)) != '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS FILE_SHARE , T2.REGISTER_USER_ID , T2.REGISTER_DATE_TIME , T2.UPDATE_USER_ID , T2.UPDATE_DATE_TIME , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = T2.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = T2.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = T2.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = T2.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME , T1.QUESTION_USER_TYPE , T1.TITLE , T1.QUESTION_TYPE , T1.FILE_CONTENT_TYPE AS ORIG_FILE_CONTENT_TYPE , T1.FILE_PATH AS ORIG_FILE_PATH , T1.FILE_TEMP_NAME AS ORIG_FILE_TEMP_NAME , T1.FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME AS ORIG_FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME , FS.REFERENCE_NO_ID AS FILE_REFERENCE_NO_ID , FS.SEQ_NO AS FILE_SEQ_NO , FS.FILE_NAME AS FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME , FS.FILE_NAME_REMOTE AS FILE_TEMP_NAME , FS.FILE_PATH_REMOTE AS FILE_PATH FROM TB_ECM_QANDA_DETAIL T2 INNER JOIN TB_ECM_QANDA T1 ON T1.REFERENCE_NO = T2.REFERENCE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT fs.REFERENCE_NO_ID , fsf.SEQ_NO , fs.FUNC_JOB_NO , fs.FUNC_REFERENCE_NO , fsf.FILE_NAME , fsf.FILE_NAME_REMOTE , fsf.FILE_PATH_REMOTE FROM TB_COM_FILE_SHARE fs LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_COM_FILE_SHARE_FILE fsf ON fs.REFERENCE_NO_ID = fsf.REFERENCE_NO_ID ) FS ON FS.FUNC_JOB_NO = T2.REFERENCE_NO AND FS.FUNC_REFERENCE_NO = CAST(T2.SEQ_NO AS VARCHAR) WHERE T2.REFERENCE_NO = #{referenceNo}

/*HubSystemMngMapper.selectHubMainNoticeList : 공지사항 List 조회*/
SELECT ntc.REFERENCE_NO ,ntc.SYSTEM_YN ,ntc.NOTICE_TYPE ,ntc.ENT_CODE ,ntc.NOTICE_DATE ,ntc.NOTICE_TIME ,ntc.NOTICE_DATE_ED ,ntc.NOTICE_TIME_ED ,ntc.REGISTER_USER_ID ,ntc.UPDATE_USER_ID ,ntc.NOTICE_YN ,ntc.SUBJECT ,ntc.FILE_TEMP_NAME ,bus.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE ,usr.USER_ID
FROM exps_master.dbo.TB_SMS_NOTICE ntc
FROM TB_SMS_NOTICE ntc
LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SMS_NOTICE_BUSINESS bus ON bus.REFERENCE_NO = ntc.REFERENCE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SMS_NOTICE_USER usr ON usr.REFERENCE_NO = ntc.REFERENCE_NO WHERE 1=1 AND (GETDATE() >= ntc.NOTICE_DATE AND GETDATE() < DATEADD(DAY, 1, ntc.NOTICE_DATE_ED))
AND ( ntc.ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} OR ntc.SYSTEM_YN = 'Y' )
AND (bus.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE IS NULL OR bus.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{srchEntBusinessCode})
AND SYSTEM_YN = 'Y' AND (USER_ID IS NULL OR USER_ID = #{srchUserId})
AND ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode}
AND SYSTEM_YN = 'N' AND NOTICE_TYPE IN ('BOARD') AND (USER_ID IS NULL OR USER_ID = #{srchUserId})
AND ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode}
AND SYSTEM_YN = 'N' AND ((NOTICE_TYPE IN ('CUSTOMER')) OR (USER_ID = #{srchUserId}))
/* HubSystemMngMapper.getDetailCount : 문의사항(QnA) - Detail Count */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ECM_QANDA_DETAIL WHERE REFERENCE_NO =#{referenceNo}
